text: dsh-cet-vocab 是面向 DSH 网页端的四六级英语词汇学习插件，在 shell.overlay 中提供可拖动、可缩放和可收起的悬浮词卡。它支持 CET-4 与 CET-6 词库、卡片记忆和带干扰选项的测验，并按学习结果安排间隔复习。用户可以查看学习统计、练习到期词或额外新词，也能循环朗读单词并设置发音口音。适合希望在 DSH 使用过程中持续积累四六级词汇的学习者；进度保存在浏览器本地，发音和例句功能会按需连接外部服务。

dsh-cet-vocab adds a floating panel to the DSH web interface for CET-4 and CET-6 flashcards, quizzes, spaced review, progress statistics, and word reading with accent options. The panel moves, resizes, and collapses. Progress stays in browser storage; audio and example lookup use external services.
想在 DSH 里随时打开四六级单词卡学习。
有没有能用间隔复习安排英语单词复习的 DSH 插件？
我想用选择题练习四级和六级词汇。
让 DSH 网页端显示一个可以拖动收起的背词窗口。
想边用 DSH 边学英语单词，还能记录每天进度。
需要一个能朗读单词并切换美音英音的词汇学习面板。
I want to study CET vocabulary with flashcards inside DSH.
Can DSH schedule spaced reviews for the English words I learn?
dsh-cet-vocab 的功能「四六级词卡」：在 DSH 悬浮面板中展示单词、音标和释义，用户可查看释义并对掌握程度评分；词库可切换四级、六级或全部。
dsh-cet-vocab 的功能「选择题」：用户可切换到测验模式，从多个选项中选择单词释义并继续下一题，用于练习词汇辨认。
dsh-cet-vocab 的功能「间隔复习」：根据单词的记忆阶段安排到期时间，并提供到期词复习及额外新词练习入口。
dsh-cet-vocab 的功能「单词朗读」：可循环朗读已学单词，并设置朗读范围、朗读内容及美式或英式口音；在线音频不可用时使用浏览器语音能力。
dsh-cet-vocab 使用前须知：单词发音会按需从 dict.youdao.com 获取音频，例句查询会把词条发往 dictionaryapi.dev 或 Tatoeba。
dsh-cet-vocab 使用前须知：学习进度和设置保存在当前浏览器配置的 localStorage 中，清除站点数据会影响本地记录。

dsh-cet-vocab README · dsh-cet-vocab / 背单词（四六级）：A CET-4 / CET-6 vocabulary trainer for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (dsh) Web UI: a draggable, minimizable floating word-card window you can open any time — including while the model is thinking.

一个 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web 界面的四六级背单词悬浮窗：可拖动、可最小化，随时点开背单词——包括模型思考的空档期。

dsh-cet-vocab README · Features / 功能：- **Word list / 词库** — 5,805 words (CET-4 3,849 / CET-6 5,407, deduplicated), extracted from [ECDICT](https://github.com/skywind3000/ECDICT) by tag and sorted by frequency. The list is bundled into the client, so the plugin works fully offline. 词库按 cet4/cet6 标签从 ECDICT 提取、按词频排序，内嵌进前端，运行时不需要网络。
- **Two study modes / 两种模式** — flip-card with three-button grading (known / fuzzy / unknown), or multiple-choice quiz with distractors picked from confusable words (edit distance, shared prefix/suffix/bigrams). 翻卡三键评分（认识/模糊/不认识），或形近词干扰项的选择题模式。
- **Spaced repetition / 间隔复习** — Ebbinghaus-style ladder (10 min → 1 d → 2 d → 4 d → 8 d → 16 d); failed cards reset and re-queue after 10 minutes. 艾宾浩斯阶梯复习，答错 10 分钟后重新进队。
- **Daily plan / 每日计划** — configurable daily new-word quota (0–500); today's review count shown on the pill badge. 每日新词数可自定义（0–500），药丸徽标显示今日待复习数。
- **Review / extra practice / 复习与加练** — when today's quota is done, review due cards (≤20) or practice 10 unseen words; practice results don't consume the quota. 完成当日额度后可复习到期词或加练未学词，不计额度。
- **Auto-open / 思考时自动弹出** — opens the window automatically whenever a session starts running; toggleable in settings.
dsh-cet-vocab README · Features / 功能：Progress is stored in `localStorage` (per browser profile). 进度存于浏览器 `localStorage`。

dsh-cet-vocab README · Install / 安装：From any DSH plugin marketplace that mirrors the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) catalog (e.g. dshmarket, dsh-plugin-mall), or directly / 或直接：

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-cet-vocab                      # from npm
dsh plugin add "https://github.com/zhuran305-web/dsh-cet-vocab/releases/latest/download/dsh-cet-vocab.tgz"   # from GitHub Releases
```

dsh-cet-vocab README · Install / 安装：The package ships prebuilt `client.js` — no build step, no telemetry. Pronunciation streams one small mp3 per word from Youdao's dictionary audio on demand (cached by the browser); everything else works offline. 包内自带构建好的 client.js，无构建步骤、无遥测。发音按需流式加载有道词典音频（浏览器自带缓存），其余功能完全离线。

dsh-cet-vocab README · Build from source / 从源码构建：```sh
node scripts/build_client.mjs   # embeds data/words.json into client.js
```

`data/words.json` is generated from ECDICT (`scripts/build_words.py` filters the `cet4`/`cet6` tags); download the [ECDICT](https://github.com/skywind3000/ECDICT) release CSV to `data/ecdict.csv` to regenerate it.

dsh-cet-vocab README · Release / 发版：```sh
node scripts/release.mjs 0.2.2 --dry-run   # 彩排：构建/冒烟/打包/解包复核/临时 profile 安装验证，然后自动还原
node scripts/release.mjs 0.2.2             # 正式发版：提交推送 → tag → GitHub Release → npm publish → 核验
```

dsh-cet-vocab README · Release / 发版：One command runs the whole chain: sync the three i18n places, bump the version, rebuild `client.js`, smoke-test the working copy, pack, unpack the tarball and smoke-test it again (byte-comparing `client.js` against the build), install the tarball into a throwaway DSH profile through the real CLI, then commit, tag, publish a GitHub Release and publish to npm — verifying both channels afterwards. 一条命令跑完整条发版链路，失败时会还原 dry-run 产生的临时改动。

dsh-cet-vocab README · Release / 发版：| script | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `scripts/release.mjs` | the one-command release above (`--dry-run`, `--no-npm`, `--no-github`, `--skip-smoke`, …) |
| `scripts/build_client.mjs` | embeds `data/words.json` into `client.js` and syntax-checks the result |
| `scripts/sync_locale.mjs [--check]` | keeps `locale/zh.json` + `locale/en.json` identical to the inline dictionaries in `client.src.js` |
| `scripts/smoke_release_install.mjs [dir] [reference client.js]` | 56–57 structural checks: package fields, `shell.overlay` registration, locale wiring, embedded word list |

dsh-cet-vocab README · Release / 发版：Requirements: an authenticated `gh`, and an npm **granular access token with “Bypass 2FA” enabled** (npm requires 2FA, or such a token, to publish) supplied via `--token-file` or `NPM_TOKEN_FILE`. GitHub traffic uses the proxy from `--proxy` (default `http://127.0.0.1:7897`); npm is deliberately called without a proxy. The npm credential is written to a temporary userconfig and deleted afterwards — `~/.npmrc` is never touched. 需要已登录的 `gh`，以及开启 Bypass 2FA 的 npm granular token；GitHub 走代理、npm 不走代理，凭据只落在临时配置里且用完即删。

dsh-cet-vocab README · 0.2.5：- **边界适应 / Edge-aware window** — 悬浮按钮拖到屏幕右侧后点开，卡片按 `384 × 缩放` 的真实视觉宽度自动内收，不再溢出右边界；不改动已保存的位置，收起后仍在原处；DSH 侧栏或窗口尺寸变化时实时重算。The expanded card now fits itself inside the viewport by its real scaled width, without moving the saved pill position, and re-fits on viewport resize.
- **真实挤压 / Squeeze, don't swap** — 贴边时按钮文字被空间逐字压成一列（📖 / 背 / 单 / 词），由布局压力驱动，不是阈值切换或淡入淡出。Near the edge the pill label genuinely reflows into a column under layout pressure — no breakpoint switch, no cross-fade.
- **防误触 / Safer reset** — 「重置全部进度」移入二级页「数据与重置」，首页改为低权重入口（显示已学词数）；二次确认 3.5 秒自动失效、危险态实心红、明确显示将清空多少词。Reset moved into a "Data & reset" sub-page; the confirmation now expires after 3.5s, turns solid red, and names how many words will be erased.
- **Star 鼓励 / Star the repo** — 设置页新增 Star 按钮，打开项目主页（浏览器插件无法代替用户授权）。A "Star the repo" button opens the project page, since a client plugin cannot authorise on the user's behalf.

dsh-cet-vocab README · 0.2.4：- **斩单词 / Cut** — 「⚔ 斩」不删除、不毕业：词转入记忆阶段 6 的低频维护池，按可配间隔（15/30/60 天）抽查，抽查答错自动打回阶段 1。统计页可查看「已斩」列表并随时召回，抽查词带「维护抽查」角标；循环朗读默认排除已斩词。Cut words move to a low-frequency maintenance pool (memory stage 6) with configurable 15/30/60-day checks instead of being deleted; a failed check returns the word to stage 1. A cut list with recall, a maintenance-check badge, and reader filtering are included.
- **界面精修 / UI polish** — 设计令牌统一间距/圆角/字号/过渡，减少重复边框，统一焦点与按压反馈，`prefers-reduced-motion` 守卫；保留朗读开关的声波环并修复其定位漂移。Design tokens, fewer borders, consistent focus/press feedback, reduced-motion guard, and the sound-wave ring anchored correctly to the reader toggle.
- **例句朗读双渠道 / Example sentences** — 词典 API 与 Tatoeba 语料库回落，无例句自动跳过。Dictionary API with Tatoeba corpus fallback; words without examples are skipped silently.
- **选择题 / Quiz** — 答完四个选项都显示对应单词，反馈条只显示判定不再重复释义。All four option words appear after answering; the verdict line no longer repeats the definition.

dsh-cet-vocab README · 0.2.2：- **Keyboard shortcuts / 快捷键** — `Alt+Q` shows or hides the window (works even while typing), `Alt+1` / `Alt+2` switch card vs. quiz, `Alt+R` review, `Alt+P` extra practice, `Alt+X` exit practice, `Alt+S` speak the word; `Space` flips, `1/2/3` grade, `1–4` answer, `→` moves to the next word. Bare keys stay inert while a text field has focus or the window is closed, and any key the host already handled is left alone. The full list is in Settings. 全套快捷键，设置页附键位指南。
- **Leaner settings / 设置页瘦身** — the word book, daily quota and accent now live on a single 「学习」 sub-page; the separate 「自定义」 row is gone and its number box sits inline at the end of the daily-quota row. 词库/每日新词/发音口音收进「学习」二级页，自定义输入框并入每日新词行。
- **Quiz fixes / 选择题修正** — options and the feedback line show the whole definition (the 46-character cut is gone), and a wrong answer now stays on screen instead of auto-advancing after 1.2 s: press `→` or the new 「下一个」 button to continue. 释义不再截断；答错会停留，按 → 或「下一个」继续。
- **Resizable / 可缩放** — drag the corner grip to scale the entire window, text and spacing included, from 70% to 200%; double-click the grip to reset, and the size is remembered. 拖动右下角手柄整体缩放，双击复位，尺寸持
dsh-cet-vocab README · 0.2.1：Publishable npm package (dropped `private`, declared `engines.dsh`); `locale/*.json` aligned with the inline dictionaries.
dsh-cet-vocab README · 0.2.0：Online human US/UK pronunciation fetched per word, with `speechSynthesis` as the offline fallback — no Windows voice pack or admin rights needed. 在线真人美式/英式发音，无需语音包与管理员权限。

dsh-cet-vocab README · Data license / 词库来源：The word list is extracted from [ECDICT](https://github.com/skywind3000/ECDICT) (MIT License, © skywind3000). Everything else is MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
